items.name: DichromaticMap
items.description: An interactive viewer and Python library for cubic grain-boundary dichromatic patterns, coincidence sites, crystal vectors, and common cells.
items.imageAlt: DichromaticMap viewer showing an FCC grain-boundary pattern, coincidence sites, and analysis controls

items.name: AlloyView
items.description: A browser-based viewer for atomistic structures and trajectories in metals and alloys. Open CFG or LAMMPS files, analyze crystal environments, and export figures locally.
items.imageAlt: AlloyView displaying an FCC crystal with a vacancy, colored by coordination number, alongside structure analysis controls

items.name: ncmconvertor
items.description: A privacy-first browser tool that restores NetEase Cloud Music .ncm cache files to MP3, FLAC, M4A, or OGG. Conversion runs locally with Rust and WebAssembly, so files never leave your device.
items.imageAlt: ncmconvertor browser interface with a local file drop zone, format description, and privacy notice
